---
title: Errors
description: Every error class that forges throws.
icon: i-lucide-circle-alert
---

All errors extend `ForgeError`. Errors from a request carry `forge`, `instance`, `url` and `method`. Each class also has the fields of the classes it extends. See [Handle errors and rate limits](/guides/errors).

<!-- errors:start -->

::error-reference
| Class | Extends | Thrown when | Fields |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ForgeError` | `Error` | Base class for every error that forges throws. | `forge?: ForgeKind`<br>`instance?: ForgeInstance`<br>`url?: string`<br>`method?: string` |
| `ForgeApiError` | `ForgeError` | The forge responded with an error. | `status: number`<br>`body: string`: Truncated response body, for diagnostics. |
| `NotFoundError` | `ForgeApiError` | A 404: the resource does not exist, or the credential cannot see it. Many forges respond the same way to both. |  |
| `AuthenticationRequiredError` | `ForgeApiError` | A 401 for a request sent without credentials. A rejected credential is `TokenRevokedError`. |  |
| `RateLimitedError` | `ForgeApiError` | A rate limit was hit and a retry didn't help. | `resetAt?: Date`<br>`secondary: boolean`: A secondary (abuse) limit, which has no remaining-request counter. |
| `TokenRevokedError` | `ForgeApiError` | The credential was revoked or expired. |  |
| `InsufficientScopeError` | `ForgeApiError` | The credential is valid but lacks the scope or permission for this call. |  |
| `ForbiddenError` | `ForgeApiError` | The forge refused the request for a reason other than a missing scope: an organisation policy, an SSO requirement, an abuse limit, or a protected resource. A missing scope is `InsufficientScopeError`. | `reason: ForbiddenReason` (`'org_restriction'`, `'sso_required'`, `'rate_limit_abuse'`, `'resource_protected'`, `'unknown'`)<br>`reasonRaw?: string`: The forge's own wording, for diagnostics and for reasons not yet mapped. |
| `MergeBlockedError` | `ForgeApiError` | The pull request cannot be merged yet, typically because of failing or pending checks or branch protection. |  |
| `MergeConflictError` | `ForgeApiError` | The merge conflicts with the base branch, or the head moved since `sha` was read. |  |
| `UnsupportedOperationError` | `ForgeError` | The forge doesn't support the operation. |  |
| `ReadOnlyError` | `UnsupportedOperationError` | A write was called on a provider constructed with `readOnly: true`. |  |
| `ForgeTimeoutError` | `ForgeError` | A request or a pending merge exceeded `timeout`. | `timeout: number` |
| `SubscriptionClosedError` | `ForgeError` | A subscription connection closed or failed. Resume from `cursor`. | `cursor?: string` |
| `ForgeNetworkError` | `ForgeError` | The request never got a response: DNS, TLS, connection refused or a proxy refusal. |  |
| `WebhookVerificationError` | `ForgeError` | A delivery's signature didn't match. |  |
| `ContentNotTextError` | `ForgeError` | `contents.file` was asked for text and the file's bytes are not valid UTF-8. |  |
| `UnknownForgeError` | `ForgeError` | A ref names a forge instance no registered provider serves. |  |
| `UnresolvedThreadError` | `ForgeError` | The thread ref has no number, or is a kind the provider cannot address. |  |
| `MergeMethodRequiredError` | `ForgeError` | No merge method was given, and the repository allows several or reports none. | `allowed: MergeMethod[]` (`'merge'`, `'squash'`, `'rebase'`, `'rebase_merge'`, `'fast_forward_only'`) |
